about_the_game:
Reduce thousands of zombie foods to mush!

The Last Kich of Us is a survivors-like / bullet heaven / auto-shooter type action rogue-lite that immerses you in a quirky post-apocalyptic universe, enhanced by its hand-drawn characters.

Gain power to pulverize hordes of zombie foods. Play as iconic characters, referencing various pop culture universes, with their own unique skills, and complete the ultimate battle of Kichman, the last slice of quiche that can unite all powers!

It's time to prove that even if you happen to be a quiche (French expression to say that you are hopeless), your fate is not sealed!

Play as iconic characters!

From a young wizard to a space knight, including superheroes, each character has powers specific to each universe!

Risk your life in the putrid gas!

Beware of the putrid gas that surrounds and moves around you. The negative effects it causes vary depending on its color. You'll have to find the right moment to risk venturing into it to collect resources or escape from enemies.

Make the right choices to survive!

Whether it's choosing upgrades and skills. Or deciding whether to brave the putrid gas to collect XP or an energy orb, your only way to improve your character in the middle of combat.
Will you be able to optimize Kichman's skills in time to survive the waves of ever-increasing and powerful zombie foods?

Experiment unusual combinations that could prove devastating!

Kichman will be able to use the skills of the game's various characters once unlocked. This gives you the opportunity to create power combinations that blend different pop culture universes. Each unlocked skill opens the door to new builds!

name: The Last Kich Of Us
short_description: Pulverize hordes of zombie food in this survivors-like. Everyone else has been turned into a zombie except you, you're the last slice of quiche! Survive by launching attacks referencing various pop culture universes, while avoiding the ever-evolving putrid gas.
